title: Studying Different Ways of Using Oral Nicotine Pouches to Understand the Effect on Nicotine Delivery, Appeal, and Side Effects Among Adult Cigarette Smokers
official: The Place Study: Exploring the Effects of Oral Nicotine Pouch Use Topography on Measured Abuse Liability and Adverse Effects
summary: This clinical trial studies how different ways of using oral nicotine pouches (ONPs) affect nicotine delivery, appeal, and side effects among adult cigarette smokers. ONPs are tobacco-free nicotine products that contain nicotine but no tobacco leaf and are used by placing them between the lip and gum. Because ONPs are not burned and do not contain tobacco leaf, they are being studied as a replacement for tobacco products to lower harmful effects, particularly among adult cigarette smokers. However, previous research on ONP use has often been done via controlled assessments which had users place them in one area of the mouth, which does not reflect how they are used in the real-world. Researchers believe this approach leaves gaps in knowledge on how nicotine is delivered, sensory effects, craving and withdrawal, appeal, and side effects. This trial will have participants use ONPs in different ways, such as placed between the upper lip and gum, placed between the lower lip and gum, and placing them however they would like. Researchers hope that by studying these different use patterns they will understand more about how they affect nicotine delivery, appeal, and side effects among adult cigarette smokers.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Read and speak English
* At least 21 years old
* Established cigarette smoker, defined as having smoked at least 100 lifetime cigarettes and smoking at least 5 cigarettes per day for at least the past year, and have a baseline expired carbon monoxide (eCO) of 7ppm or higher at visit 1
* Willing to provide informed consent and abstain from all tobacco, nicotine, and marijuana use for at least 12 hours prior to study visits
* Willing to attend all study visits and use study ONPs
* Owns a smartphone and is able to receive short message service (SMS) text messages with embedded survey links for daily diary surveys
* Willing to provide a urine sample
* Willing to provide blood samples during the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unstable or significant psychiatric conditions; past and stable conditions will be allowed
* History of cardiac event or distress within the past 3 months
* History of uncontrolled blood pressure or shortness of breath in the past 3 months
* Currently experiencing problems with irregular heartbeat or abnormal heart rhythm that requires medication
* Currently pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Pregnancy status will be verified with urine pregnancy testing before clinic visits when applicable
* Engaged in a quit smoking attempt in the prior two weeks
* Currently engaging in a tobacco quit attempt, interested in quitting all tobacco, or planning to quit all tobacco in the next 2 months
* Oral health issues that would affect use of an ONP in the upper or lower lip for 30 minutes
* History of weekly ONP use for 3 months or longer
* Any ONP use in the past 3 months
* History of problematic blood draws
